result.title: Goal Revelation as a Bridge Between Information-Theoretic Empowerment and Capability-Based Human Power
result.summary: Power matters for AI safety. Optimal agents tend to acquire power across a wide range of objectives (instrumental convergence). As we embed AI agents into socio-technical systems, humans risk gradual disempowerment. Both concerns call for a formal, quantitative measure of power. Two such measures in the context of Markov games are information-theoretic empowerment, the capacity of the channel from an agent's actions to future states, and capability-based individual power, a measure of goal attainment built from the probabilities that a human would attain each goal in a family of candidates were they pursuing it. We show where the two meet. From individual power, Fano's inequality yields a floor $B(s)$. This floor is a lower bound on what we term goal revelation, the mutual information $\mathbb{I}(G;ξ\mid s)$ between the human's latent goal and the realised trajectory. Empowerment caps revelation from above, so that $B(s) \le \mathbb{I}(G;ξ\mid s) \le \mathbb{I}(\mathbf{A}_h \to ξ\mid s) \le \mathfrak{E}_h(s)$. Each quantity can be large while the one below it stays at zero, highlighting the following failure modes. An assistant maximising empowerment can prefer an interface offering broad influence over goal-irrelevant degrees of freedom to one that lets the human attain every goal they might hold. An assistant maximising revelation cannot tell a working interface from one rewired so that every goal yields the wrong outcome, since relabelling goals leaves mutual information unchanged while zeroing every attainment probability. Positive guarantees therefore come only from the attainment end of the chain. A satisfaction floor, computable from two statistics of interaction logs, offers a way to monitor the power users retain in a deployed system, and simulations in random environments show the three quantities are correlated but far from interchangeable.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在 Markov 博弈框架下比较两种权力度量，即信息论 empowerment 与基于目标达成概率的个体能力，并引入「目标揭示」互信息，构造「达到下界—揭示—empowerment 上界」的链条，指出各量可同时很大却互不等价，并以交互日志统计给出可监控的满足度下界。
AI.relevance_reason: 用互信息衡量 latent 目标与实现轨迹之间的可辨识度，可能为判断 LVR 内部状态是否真正携带任务必要信息、以及「信息量高但目标未达成」这类失效模式提供度量视角，其向视觉推理状态评价的可迁移性有待核查。
